title: Monte Carlo Tree Diffusion with Multiple Experts for Protein Design (MCTD-ME)
relevance: Integrates masked diffusion with MCTS for protein design. Uses biophysical-fidelity-enhanced diffusion denoising as rollout engine. Direct inspiration for combining diffusion with guided stability optimization.
key_finding: Masked diffusion as rollout engine enables multi-token planning in protein sequence spaces, outperforming autoregressive planners.

title: MutaPLM: Protein Language Modeling for Mutation Explanation and Engineering
relevance: Protein delta network capturing explicit mutation representations. Could provide guidance signal for diffusion-based mutation sampling.
key_finding: Protein delta network captures mutation representations in unified feature space, enabling mutation explanation and prioritization.

title: AI-enabled Alkaline-resistant Evolution of Protein to Apply in Mass Production
relevance: AI-guided protein evolution for industrial applications. Demonstrates practical application of computational guidance for mutation selection at scale.
key_finding: AI-enabled approach achieves alkaline-resistant protein variants for mass production applications.
